summary: XORTX Therapeutics Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of Depesh Narotam as an independent director effective July 27, 2026. Mr. Narotam, a 20-year financial services veteran, also joins the Compensation, Governance and Nominating Committee. The filing does not disclose any stake, price, or premium. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine director appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure. The event lacks the significance typical of a special situation. What to watch: any subsequent material changes in board composition or strategy.
